resolved.title: select 语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Select[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]select[/b] statement is used to wait on multiple channel operations. 

The syntax is similar to [b]switch[/b] except that each of the case statements will be a channel operation.
Let's use the same program from our previous example and select the channel that is ready first:[code format="go" codeId="3364"]evenCh := make(chan int)
sqCh := make(chan int)

go evenSum(0, 100, evenCh)
go squareSum(0, 100, sqCh)

select {
  case x := <- evenCh:
    fmt.Println(x)
  case y := <- sqCh:
    fmt.Println(y)
}[/code]
The [b]select[/b] statement waits for a channel to receive data and executes its [b]case[/b].
This means that only one of the cases will execute -- the one that corresponds to the channel that receives data first.
If both channels receive data at the same time, one of the cases is chosen randomly.
[note]Combining Goroutines and channels with select is a powerful feature of Go. 
Imagine a program that needs to execute some code whenever one of the concurrent operations completes -- this can be achieved using [b]select[/b].[/note]

其语法与**switch**相似，只是每个case语句都将是一个管道操作。

content.text_html:
The select statement is used to wait on multiple channel operations.

The syntax is similar to switch except that each of the case statements will be a channel operation. Let's use the same program from our previous example and select the channel that is ready first:

select语句用于等待多个通道的操作。

其语法与switch相似，只是每个case语句都将是一个通道操作。 让我们使用前面例子中的同一个程序，并选择先准备好的通道。

content.short_content:
evenCh := make(chan int)
sqCh := make(chan int)

go evenSum(0, 100, evenCh)
go squareSum(0, 100, sqCh)

select {
    case x := <- evenCh:

        fmt.Println(y)
}

content.text:
**select**语句等待一个管道接收数据并执行其**case**语句。
这意味着只有一个**case**被执行-- 对应首先收到数据的管道。
如果两个管道同时收到数据，则会随机选择其中一个case。

想象一下，一个程序需要在其中一个并发操作完成时执行一些代码 -- 则可以通过**select**来实现。

resolved.title: select 语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Select[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]select[/b] can have a [b]default[/b] case, which will execute when no channel is ready. 
For example, we could have an infinite [b]for[/b] loop, waiting for one of the channels to receive data: [code format="go" codeId="3365"]for {
  select {
    case x := <- evenCh:
      fmt.Println(x)
      return
    case y := <- sqCh:
      fmt.Println(y)
      return
[b]    default:[/b]
      fmt.Println("Nothing available")
      time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
  }
}[/code]
The [b]for[/b] loop uses a [b]select[/b] to check which channel got data. If none of them are ready, the [b]default[/b] case will execute which will wait for 50ms. 
As soon as a channel gets data, the [b]return[/b] statement will exit the loop.
[note]A [b]select[/b] statement blocks until at least one of its cases can proceed. The [b]default[/b] case is useful in preventing [b]deadlocks -- [/b]without it the [b]select[/b] would wait for a channel forever, crashing the program if none of the channels received data.[/note]

content.text:
一个**select**语句可以有一个**默认**的情况，当没有管道准备好时，它将执行。
例如，有一个无限的**for**循环，等待其中一个管道接收数据：
content.text_html:
A select can have a default case, which will execute when no channel is ready. For example, we could have an infinite for loop, waiting for one of the channels to receive data:

一个选择可以有一个默认的情况，当没有通道准备好时，它将执行。 例如，我们可以有一个无限的for循环，等待其中一个通道接收数据。

content.text:
**for**使用一个**select**来检查哪个管道有数据。如果都没有准备好，**默认**(default)情况将被执行，它等待50ms。
一旦一个管道收到数据，**return**语句将退出循环。
content.text_html:
The for loop uses a select to check which channel got data. If none of them are ready, the default case will execute which will wait for 50ms. As soon as a channel gets data, the return statement will exit the loop.

循环的for使用一个select来检查哪个通道有数据。如果它们都没有准备好，默认的情况将被执行，它将等待50ms。 一旦一个通道得到数据，return语句将退出循环。

content.text: **select**语句会被阻塞，直到至少有一个case可以进行。**default**则可以防止**死锁**。没有它，**select**将永远等待一个管道(如果没有一个管道收到数据)，程序将崩溃。
content.text_html:
A select statement blocks until at least one of its cases can proceed. The default case is useful in preventing **deadlocks -- **without it the select would wait for a channel forever, crashing the program if none of the channels received data.

一个选择语句会阻塞，直到至少有一个情况可以进行。default情况在防止死锁方面很有用--没有它，select将永远等待一个通道，如果没有一个通道收到数据，程序将崩溃。

```go

  case <-ch1:
    fmt.Println(1)
  case <- ch2:
    fmt.Println(2)
  default: 
    fmt.Println(3)
}
```
